clips.title: The story
paras: In western Duskwood, shadows move through Raven Hill, and a light flickers in a ruined window. Elaine Carevin sends travelers from Darkshire to learn what has taken shelter there.

The Night Watch has long left Duskwood’s far west to the dead and wilderness. Yet signs of life there demand attention. Calor, a watcher on the gloomy roads, saw movement among Raven Hill’s silent houses two nights in a row. A lantern flickered in a window. With ghouls, skeletons, and beasts across the land, the Night Watch cannot ignore what stirs among the ruins.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Something's amiss at Raven Hill, friend. Calor swears that someone--or something--is haunting the buildings there. Two nights running he's noticed the shadows moving, and the third before that he says he saw light in one of the windows.
If, as you say, you care about the safety of Duskwood, find out what monster haunts in Raven Hill.

clips.title: Completion
paras: No! Please don't kill me! It's just me... Jitters!! They're everywhere... I can't escape them! Monsters in Raven Hill? N-n-n-o... Couldn't be. Only harmless Jitters.
